exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: faithful historical Silent Storm softly PAINTED COLOR diffuse bitmap, not a photo.

Input1 is exact entire native original RGBA. Input2 is identical whole original storedRGB nearest-neighbor enlargement, source-only with no crops/patches. Refine this exact whole source bitmap with restrained fine painted detail only. Preserve full normalized UV, original pigment positions/phase/scale, broad soft blur, muted source palette, weak local relationships and every existing shape. The original complete alpha will be restored and brightness corrected by one scalar only.

Keep the ONE complete brown/golden softly painted curled hair field with ONE original central part. Exactly retain the source winding strokes, small curl shapes, their native positions/count/phase, broad paired pigment banks and uneven dark outer border. This is the SAME source bitmap, not a redesigned hairstyle or photograph. Do not add new locks or curls, regularize the original irregular pigment into uniform waves, replace it with straight gray fill, sharpen it into radial fibers, enlarge the light bands or make glossy metal-like ribbons. Preserve muted brown local washes and fine painterly softness.

Output ENTIRE square source canvas edge-to-edge with precisely the same normalized UV. No crop, BBox, fitting, zoom, padding, margins, transparent cutout, registration, artistic RGB repairs, new text/symbols/parts, weave/grain, photonoise or invented relief. Keep source relative brightness and soft edges; no locally strengthened white highlights.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Whole native storedRGBA to opaqueRGB NEAREST6x only, no crop/BBox/registration/padding/rotate/unpremultiply/sourceartRGB repair. Original fullA separately restored; ENTIRE raw inverse original4x/pure scalar/defaultpad.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
